title: AI Search Visibility & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Monitoring
category: AI Innovation / Technical SEO / Marketing Automation
status: Monitoring infrastructure implemented; commercial performance measurement pending.
summary: Designed and implemented an AI search visibility monitoring framework for Airocide Systems, extending traditional SEO measurement into Generative Engine Optimization.
description: Integrated Search Atlas's AI Visibility API with n8n Cloud to establish monitoring capabilities for AI-generated brand exposure, competitive positioning, citation activity, and industry-specific commercial search intent.
accomplishments: Established six commercial AI visibility tracking categories aligned with Airocide's primary B2B markets.
Configured and validated 42 active AI search queries covering industry applications, purchasing considerations, and commercial air purification solutions.
Developed API-connected workflows for retrieving brand visibility, competitor positioning, and topic-level performance data.
Created custom reporting logic to distinguish commercial and residential visibility.
Reduced active monitoring scope from 84 queries to 42, a 50% reduction, while preserving residential topics for future reactivation.
Implemented verification and workflow safeguards to protect existing reporting infrastructure.
impact: Established a foundation for continuously evaluating how Airocide is discovered, cited, and represented in AI-generated search experiences.
Supports the identification of competitive visibility gaps, emerging commercial search opportunities, and potential SEO/GEO content priorities.
Creates a framework for tracking AI search exposure over time as AI-driven product research and purchasing behavior evolves.
measurement_note: Commercial AI visibility improvements, citation growth, engagement, and lead-generation impact have not yet been established. Future reporting will depend on successful Search Atlas scans and available performance data.
